_readme: Example only. Copy this file to profile.json (same folder) and replace every value with your own. Keys that start with '_' are ignored by deadlines.py.

_field_help.name: Your name (only used in the report heading).
_field_help.branch: One of: army, navy, marine-corps, air-force, space-force, coast-guard.
_field_help.separation_date: Planned separation or retirement date, YYYY-MM-DD.
_field_help.gi_bill_transferred: true if you have already transferred your Post-9/11 GI Bill to a spouse or children, otherwise false. When true, the GI Bill transfer decision row is hidden. Default: false.
_field_help.plans_after: Short note, for example: work, school, business, undecided.
_field_help.state_planned: State where you plan to live after you leave, for example: TX.
_field_help.saved_on: Date you last updated this file, YYYY-MM-DD.
_field_help.reminder_cadence: How often you want reminders: daily, weekly, biweekly, or monthly. Default: weekly.
_field_help.reminder_day: Day of the week for reminders, for example: Monday. Ignored for daily. For monthly, the first such day of each month. For biweekly, every other week starting from the first such day on or after saved_on.
_field_help.timezone: IANA time zone name, for example: America/Chicago.
_field_help.lookahead_days: How many days ahead deadlines.py looks by default. Default: 30.
